properties.name: Jesus' journey to Jerusalem
properties.dateLabel: c. AD 26-36; sequence and dating vary
properties.description: A schematic corridor connecting places named along Gospel journeys toward Jerusalem. Luke describes travel through Samaria; the final approach names Jericho, Bethany, Bethphage, and Jerusalem. The Gospels do not give a measured road or a single agreed itinerary.
properties.confidence: Named places are textual; the connecting line is illustrative.
properties.precision: Regional corridor; exact roads and some chronology are uncertain.

properties.name: Peter from Lydda to Joppa and Caesarea
properties.dateLabel: Early apostolic period; exact year not stated
properties.description: Acts records Peter at Lydda, then Joppa, and later traveling to Caesarea at Cornelius's invitation. The timeline window is broad for context; Acts does not date this itinerary to a specific year.
properties.confidence: The sequence is named in Acts; date and road are not specified.
properties.precision: Town-to-town schematic; not a surveyed road.

properties.name: Paul and Barnabas' first missionary journey
properties.travelers: Paul, Barnabas, and at first John Mark
properties.description: Acts names the principal stops of this outward and return journey through Cyprus and southern Asia Minor. The line connects those places in sequence; it does not claim the exact roads taken between them.
properties.confidence: Itinerary is textually attested; date and connecting roads are approximate.
properties.precision: Regional city-to-city route; some ancient sites are identified approximately.

properties.name: Paul's voyage to Rome
properties.travelers: Paul and other prisoners under Roman guard
properties.description: Acts follows Paul's guarded sea voyage from Caesarea through ports in the eastern Mediterranean, the shipwreck on Malta, and the final passage to Rome. The track between named stops is schematic; storm-driven drift and the exact ship path are not reconstructed.
properties.confidence: Named itinerary is textually attested; the year and sea track are approximate.
properties.precision: Maritime route corridor; exact track and shipwreck point are uncertain.
